description:
`Filament.LiveView.dispatch_filament_event/3` currently does a flat `FiberTree.get_event_handler/3` lookup and invokes the handler directly. Reroute through `Filament.Core.dispatch_event/3` so the capture/bubble walk runs on web events too.

## Acceptance
- All existing examples still respond to clicks / submits / key events the same way.
- New test: a parent component's capture handler fires before the target's handler (proves the walk runs).
title: Phase 3.3: LiveView adapter delegates to Core dispatcher
